buying-guide.text: MOQ depends on product and technique. Include your target quantity so the applicable minimum can be confirmed. The quantity selector is not an MOQ guarantee.

buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容

buying-guide.text: Ask for a digital artwork proof in your brief. Proof scope, cost, revision allowances and timing are agreed for each project.

buying-guide.text: Which Artwork Should I Provide?

buying-guide.label: 正文 · Upload JPG, PNG, PDF or ZIP files with your quot
buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: Upload JPG, PNG, PDF or ZIP files with your quote enquiry (up to 3 files, 2 MB total), or share an accessible file link. Include dimensions, placement and color references. Vector artwork is useful when available; a clear reference image can start the discussion.

buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容

buying-guide.label: 正文 · Confirm fiber composition, fabric weight, measur
buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: Confirm fiber composition, fabric weight, measurements and tolerances for the selected product. Images and selectable sizes do not replace an approved specification sheet.

buying-guide.label: 正文 · How Long Does Delivery Take
buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: How Long Does Delivery Take?

buying-guide.label: 正文 · Provide the destination and required arrival dat
buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容

buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: What About Returns Or Product Issues?

buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: Confirm return arrangements for standard products before purchase. Agree custom specifications and issue-resolution terms before approval. Contact us with the order reference and photographs if a concern arises.

buying-guide.label: 正文 · Can You Meet A Testing Or Environmental Standard
buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: Can You Meet A Testing Or Environmental Standard?

buying-guide.label: 正文 · State the exact standard and documentation requi
buying-guide.sectionLabel: 页面模块 · 采购指南内容
buying-guide.text: State the exact standard and documentation required. Certifications, material content and testing scope must be verified for the specific product; no blanket certification is claimed.
